capabilities.name: Website Discovery
capabilities.description: Category-first Playwright-driven discovery of vendor websites with JS rendering, infinite scroll, pagination, and category traversal.

capabilities.name: PDF Catalog Extraction
capabilities.description: Upload vendor PDFs; OCR; AI extraction of clickable catalog items into a Discovery Session.

capabilities.name: Manual Catalog Entry
capabilities.description: First-class manual creation of all supported Universal Catalog Item types without AI.

capabilities.name: Discovery Session Staging
capabilities.description: Temporary staging area with candidate states, search, filter, multi-select, preview, edit, bulk import, ignore, and archive before any catalog creation.

capabilities.name: Universal Catalog Management
capabilities.description: Owned catalog of products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, and installation with full CRUD, search, filtering, tags, favorites, and bulk actions.

capabilities.name: Vendor Management
capabilities.description: Create, edit, archive vendors; manage contacts, notes, categories, and sync history.

capabilities.name: Workspace Management
capabilities.description: Multi-tenant workspaces with AI settings and branding; future team support.

capabilities.name: AI Provider Adapter Architecture
capabilities.description: Pluggable AI providers via adapter interface; provider registry; capability router; retries, fallbacks, and health checks; degrades gracefully with zero providers.

capabilities.name: AI Capability Routing
capabilities.description: Route AI requests by capability (catalogExtraction, semanticSearch, etc.) instead of by provider; provider selected by router configuration.

capabilities.name: AI Extraction and Enrichment
capabilities.description: AI capabilities for product extraction, service extraction, PDF extraction, categorization, data normalization, and duplicate detection.

capabilities.name: Validation Engine
capabilities.description: Deterministic validation of AI-extracted and imported items: missing fields, duplicates, SKU, price, category, business rules, inventory conflicts. AI never writes directly to inventory.

capabilities.name: Pricing Engine
capabilities.description: Apply fixed, percentage markup, or manual pricing; compute margins. Formula pricing deferred to future.

capabilities.name: Collections
capabilities.description: Mixed item collections, reusable packages, bulk editing, and export support.

capabilities.name: Flyer Builder
capabilities.description: Drag-and-drop editor producing PDF/PNG flyers from owned catalog items with branding and templates.

capabilities.name: Quote Builder
capabilities.description: Compose mixed catalog items with quantities, taxes, discounts, and shipping into a quote PDF.

capabilities.name: Analytics
capabilities.description: Vendor spend, monthly spend, margin, top vendors, category, quote, and catalog growth dashboards.

capabilities.name: Document Memory
capabilities.description: Version uploaded PDFs; detect new, removed, price-changed, and description-changed items; review before applying.

capabilities.name: Vendor Memory
capabilities.description: Track changes across website, PDF, and future imports with timeline of catalog versions, price history, new/removed offerings.

capabilities.name: Synchronization
capabilities.description: Manual sync now; incremental updates; review before applying changes. Scheduled sync deferred to future.

capabilities.name: Search and Filtering
capabilities.description: Global search; vendor, category, item-type filters; tags; favorites across catalog and discovery.

capabilities.name: Background Job Processing
capabilities.description: Background workers handle scraping and AI processing without blocking the UI; per-category scrolly/pagination jobs run independently and can be retried or resumed.

capabilities.name: Normalization
capabilities.description: Convert vendor-specific terminology and structures into Source BlendR's unified schema before AI enrichment.

operational_domains.name: Import and Discovery
operational_domains.description: Everything that brings external vendor data into Discovery Sessions.

operational_domains.name: Catalog
operational_domains.description: The owned catalog of Universal Catalog Items and its validation, pricing, and search.

operational_domains.name: Vendor
operational_domains.description: Vendor records, contacts, notes, categories, and sync history.

operational_domains.name: Platform
operational_domains.description: Workspaces, background job processing, and normalization.

operational_domains.name: AI Engine
operational_domains.description: Provider adapters, capability routing, AI extraction, enrichment, normalization, duplicate detection.

operational_domains.name: Business Outputs
operational_domains.description: Flyers, quotes, analytics generated from catalog data.

operational_domains.name: Memory and Sync
operational_domains.description: Document Memory, Vendor Memory, and synchronization across imports.

capability_dependencies.relationship: Website discovery leans on AI provider registry for AI-assisted site analysis and extraction; degrades gracefully with no provider.
PDF extraction leans on AI provider registry for AI extraction and OCR cleanup; degrades gracefully with no provider.
AI extraction capabilities are routed by the capability router.
Validation operates on AI-enriched normalized output.
Website discovery requires background job processing.
PDF extraction uses background job processing for long AI/OCR work.
Document Memory compares against prior PDF imports.
Vendor Memory compares against prior website imports.

stage_decision_brief.recommended_direction: Build Source BlendR as an AI-agnostic Vendor Intelligence Platform: multi-tenant workspaces, Playwright-first website discovery, PDF catalog extraction, Discovery Session staging before import, Universal Catalog Items (products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, installation), AI Provider Adapter Architecture with capability routing, background workers, and deferred future features per the PRD.
alternatives_considered: Single AI provider only (rejected: violates AI-agnostic locked principle)
Auto-import without Discovery Sessions (rejected: violates discovery-before-import locked principle)
Product-only catalog (rejected: violates Universal Catalog Items locked decision)
Plug-in marketplace architecture (rejected: explicitly out of scope in Inference Layer summary)
key_decisions: Playwright is the locked web discovery engine
AI is provider-agnostic via adapter architecture and capability router
Discovery Sessions always gate catalog imports
Universal Catalog Items replace Product-only schema
Manual entry is a first-class workflow; platform runs with zero AI providers
Background workers handle scraping and AI processing
PDF imports are equal in status to website imports
Flyer and Quote Builders are should-have; may be trimmed or deferred to protect MVP risk

assumptions.assumption: Playwright + AI-assisted site analysis handles the majority of target-market vendor sites.
Target users value provider independence and owned catalog data.
Discovery Sessions are accepted as friction-positive vs auto-import competitors.
Universal Catalog Items cover the target market without forcing partial re-architecture.
Background workers keep the UI responsive for expected scrape/AI durations without a streaming UI.

risks.description: Playwright reliability across diverse vendor sites
Target market too small or unwilling to pay

downstream_impact: Stage 2 must validate differentiation hypotheses, market demand, and technical assumptions (Playwright reliability, OCR/AI extraction quality, Universal Catalog schema coverage).
Stage 3 must lock adapter interface, capability router contract, validation engine contract, multi-tenancy isolation boundary, and queue/timeout strategy.
Stage 4 must validate Discovery Session UX and catalog browsing UX.
Stage 5 slices import-to-catalog flow, adapter architecture, and catalog as launch-critical; flyer/quote as should-have.
Stage 6 acceptance criteria must include AI extraction-quality tests per capability and validation engine tests.
